`final class UIDataScaleObject`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.core.data` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [UIDataScaleObject.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/core/data/UIDataScaleObject.java)

The interface-scale options of `@UIDataScale` for a running UI.

## Description

[`UI.getScale`](/reference/ui/ui/#UI-method-getScale) returns it; a change applies from the next frame.

## Learn more

- [The design canvas](/use/learn/describing-the-ui/design-canvas/#follow-the-interface-scale)

|---|---|---|
| [`UIDataScaleObject`](/reference/annotations/uidatascaleobject/) | [create](#UIDataScaleObject-factory-create)() <span class="joid-qualifier">factory</span> | Creates the options with the default values of [`UIDataScale`](/reference/annotations/uidatascale/). |

<a id="UIDataScaleObject-properties"></a>

## Properties

| Property | Type | Default | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| [limit](#UIDataScaleObject-property-limit) | `double` | `1D` | Largest interface scale applied when the scale is limited. |
| [active](#UIDataScaleObject-property-active) | `boolean` | `true` | If `false`, the UI ignores the interface scale. |
| [limited](#UIDataScaleObject-property-limited) | `boolean` | `false` | If `true`, the interface scale never goes above `limit`. |

<a id="UIDataScaleObject-methods"></a>

## Methods

| Returns | Signature | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `double` | [apply](#UIDataScaleObject-method-apply)(double interfaceScale) | Returns the interface scale that the UI uses for this scale of the bridge: `1` when the option is off, at most `limit` when it is limited. |
| `String` | [toString](#UIDataScaleObject-method-toString)() | Returns the class and the value of every option, for logs. |
